facts.fact: Economist Seydou Bocoum writes that the National Digital Addressing project launched in 2021 was relaunched by the Ministry of Telecommunications and Digital Affairs at a workshop on 5-6 August 2026 to finish its pilot phase within a year before any national rollout, and that public sources do not establish a fully operational national reference.
